description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeGateway synchronization functionality, specifically testing JSON decoding of gateway triggers in the VoiceWakePreferences class.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGatewaySyncTests
classes.description: A test suite that contains multiple test cases to verify correct behavior of VoiceWakePreferences JSON decoding methods.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONSanitizes
methods.description: Tests that JSON payload with triggers containing spaces or empty strings is sanitized correctly to produce the expected trigger list.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONFallsBackWhenEmpty
methods.description: Tests that an empty or whitespace-only triggers array results in falling back to default trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromInvalidJSONReturnsNil
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON input results in a nil return value, indicating failure to decode.
